## Project Details

- [Vite](https://vitejs.dev/): Frontend built with React and Vite
- [Express.js](https://expressjs.com/): Backend server handling API requests
- [Gemini API](https://ai.google.dev/): Used for generating Instagram captions with AI

## Optional

- [React Documentation](https://react.dev/): Reference for React components
- [Oxc](https://oxc.rs): Rust-based linter for the Vite plugin
